reason: The dose and the bisglycinate form are right, and a batch report behind a QR code is more than most brands give. But it is a new brand with zero reviews, and I read every review before I buy, so I would not put money in on a TikTok video alone.
objection: No reviews yet, and I cannot tell who the independent lab is or whether the report is real. Also $29.99 is above Toplux and Goli, and 200 mg in two capsules does not look like a better deal than what I can already get.
would_change_my_mind: A few dozen honest verified reviews, plus a QR report I can open now that names the lab and shows magnesium content by batch, at $24 or less per box.
